summary: Evaluates a 2-component cubic Hermite spline interpolation. Builds the four standard Hermite basis functions from the parameter t=a6 (h00=2t^3-3t^2+1, h10=t^3-2t^2+t, h01=3t^2-2t^3, h11=t^3-t^2), then blends two 2D endpoint/tangent pairs held in a2..a5 into the output vector a1. No branches, no callees.

operations.description: Compute Hermite basis h10 (v11) = t^3 - 2*t^2 + t.
Compute Hermite basis h11 (v9) = t^3 - t^2.
Write output X component at this+0x0: *a1 = h00*a2[0] + h10*a3[0] + h01*a4[0] + h11*a5[0].
Write output Y component at this+0x4: a1[1] = h11*a5[1] + h01*a4[1] + h10*a3[1] + h00*a2[1].
